specification.title: A transaction writes a marker and fails with an application error
steps: Start a transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API.
Raise an application error inside the transaction, so that the framework rolls it back.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: A transaction that the API reports as rolled back is not committed: pg_xact_status() reports it aborted, and an independent connection does not see its marker.

execution.description: SQLAlchemy Core's Connection.begin() context manager, with Connection.begin_nested() for a savepoint. pool_size 1, max_overflow 0, pool_pre_ping off. TX-03's next unit of work is a second connection from that same engine. The engine is not disposed between the units. TX-05 sets isolation_level through Connection.execution_options before begin().

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: The framework rolls the transaction back, and PostgreSQL confirms the ROLLBACK, so the client knows that nothing committed.

api_outcome.basis: Connection.begin() exited with the exception raised inside it, so it rolled back
api_outcome.contract: Connection.begin() as a context manager commits when the block exits without an exception and the transaction is still active, and rolls back when the block exits with one. Connection.begin_nested() is a SAVEPOINT; an exception there rolls back to the savepoint, and a failure of that rollback propagates. If commit() raises on the way out, TransactionalContext.__exit__ calls rollback() when it can and propagates the error from that exit.

reproduction.requires: pnpm run setup, then pnpm run pg:up (README.md)

adapter.instrumentation: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is withheld or rewritten in before_cursor_execute, before psycopg sends it. A top-level ROLLBACK is withheld on psycopg.Connection.rollback, because DefaultDialect.do_rollback calls dbapi_connection.rollback() and does not pass the cursor event. psycopg.Connection.commit is traced and not altered.
